notes.title: PC Update - Game is available for PC now!
notes.notes:
PC Game update has been published. Now this game will work on PC and VR both. 

To run the game in VR mode, Make sure that the VR is connected and SteamVR or Oculus is working. 

To run the game on PC, Simply run the game from Steam :)

Hope that you would enjoy the game!
Thanks
CHVR Team

notes.title: Set to Release in June 2019! V1
notes.notes:
Combat Helicopter VR - Surgical Strike is set to release this June 2019!

Combat Helicopter VR - Surgical Strike is an Action-Adventure based game. You are a commander of a region, and you need to perform surgical strikes on behalf of Kalta's on at Buckta's region in an F198 Helicopter in Virtual Reality. 

This is an Interactive Virtual Reality based game, Interactions are present to control the Helicopter, Use Helicopter Weaponry and external equipment to tackle. 

Help us save Kalta and make the world a better place to live. 
"KALTA NEEDS YOU".

V1 - VR Support
